name: icecream_machine_anim
playback_note: dispense plays about 4 s at normal speed

dispense.note: lever pulls, soft-serve swirls into the cup, lever returns up

notes: Frame idle_empty: empty cup, lever in its resting slot. Frame done_full: full cup, lever up.
The lever swings out to the right of the machine while pulled and ends pointing up. Keep the sprite's full canvas so the lever is not cropped.
Swirl is white vanilla. Chocolate or strawberry can be tinted in code over the swirl area, or generated as separate clips.
